entities.title: Say in each result which rules it used
entities.summary: Every result reports an empty manifest, so a resolve or toZone answer does not name the rule bundle it came from.
entities.compromise: UtvResult.ToJson writes an empty manifest, no assumptions and a lossless loss report for every result; its remarks justify this by the everyday operations being exact and the caller knowing which ZoneRules it passed.
entities.cost: A stored result cannot be checked against a later rule release, and the obligation that every nontrivial result carries a manifest of the exact rule data used (explicit-versioned-rules) is not met. The README also lists result inputDigest and contextDigest as not implemented.
acceptanceCriteria: A resolve or toZone result names the rule set (system, id, version) of the ZoneRules it used in its manifest.
Results of operations that use no rules keep an empty manifest.
dotnet test passes, including every everyday fixture.

origin.description: The remarks on UtvResult: ToJson always reports an empty manifest, no assumptions and a lossless loss report.
